answer: One fresh task per epoch stops bulk fake identities. A beacon names a canyon spring; the agent files a key-signed survey of its nectar flow. Auditors replay it on the canyon table, checking ridge height: a copied or rented survey burns a 70-credit bond. At most 12 per operator each epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 84, costing 35,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Failure: rented-survey ring. Honest agents pay 35 once, keep bond and share.
